findings.text: follow-on: the real-tree disagreement list names a single row over a reconstruction of section 1's heuristic, but section 1 kept only counts and the reconstruction's rule order lived only in the scan script that was deleted with the scratch tree, so no reader can re-derive the claim that the predicate disagrees on exactly one row; the retained real-tree-scan.log and real-tree-result.json carry the outcome but not the rule.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 73a6cdc48 - 0545d8495 adds reckon/followup_pointers.py and the roadmap wiring, 7df874037 and 7fecea42 add the evidence fragments, 4a4013a9 repairs the two test fixtures and adds the MCP summary case; all seven paths are inside the fence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names five cases and the exactly-three roadmap finding set; tests/test_a_followup_that_hides_work_is_found.py covers all five plus the sprint and recommends_skill fallback and the MCP summary path, the manifest records the base arm (73a6cdc48, 438 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0) and head arm (4a4013a9, 449 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0) logs, and the declared negative control is in negative-control.log (4 failed, 7 passed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the landed change is the node goal - one predicate in the new reckon/followup_pointers.py classifies an open followup as a pointer or as hiding work with a fixed reason word, and reckon/roadmap.py:_followup_work_findings reports each hiding open followup as a warn-severity wiring finding built on that same predicate for every plan the roadmap inventories, completed plans included.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete, the commits and landing line are present, changed_paths names all seven edited paths, and baseline_suite/after_suite both carry completed true and zero failing ids; the after_suite revision field (4a4013a9) differs from gate-head.log's own header (7df87403+working tree), which describes the same content but by a different commit.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff edits seven paths, all inside the node's declared write paths and the two test files its resume-1 advice widened the fence to (tests/test_roadmap.py, tests/test_sprint_summary_lists_pending.py); no path outside the fence was touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_followup_that_hides_work_is_found.py:136 asserts fixed reason literals per case and the declared negative control (negative-control.log) reddens the no-section case, so the guard fails on regression rather than merely passing.
justifications.evidence: the base/head arms and the negative control are on disk at the run directory, but the real-tree disagreement arm rests on a reconstruction whose encoding script is deleted with the scratch tree, so predicate-and-finding.html:62's one-row disagreement list cannot be re-derived.
justifications.fit: reckon/followup_pointers.py follows the frozen-dataclass and module-constant idiom of its neighbours and introduces no plan or stage names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/followup_pointers.py:105 classify_followup returns FollowupVerdict(pointer, reason) with the fixed word set, and reckon/roadmap.py:2920 calls the finding builder over all_plans so completed plans are judged.
justifications.scope_discipline: the base..head diff touches seven paths and every one is named in manifest.md:10 and lies inside the documented fence, including the two test files the resume-1 fence widening authorised.
